name: Coca-Cola Consolidated - Charlotte (Snyder) Production Center, NC

fieldNotes.truckGate: Controlled truck entrance off Chesapeake Dr; z20 satellite shows a guard booth and a separate small structure flanking the truck lane, with perimeter fencing and a gate point, and a truck stopped at the booth.
fieldNotes.guardShack: Dark-roofed guard booth beside the truck lane, distinct from the main building.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Multi-building campus: main production building, warehouse buildings, and ancillary structures.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Very extensive trailer parking — diagonal stalls on the west and north sides hold 100+ trailers.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Large production/warehouse buildings with dock banks on multiple faces; estimated 60+ doors total.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Dock banks on different building faces (north and southwest) indicate separate shipping/receiving clusters.
fieldNotes.railServed: A rail line runs along the west boundary but appears to serve the adjacent property; no clear spur into Coca-Cola docks — left false, flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.scale: No clear truck scale identified; left false, flagged uncertain.
